fdroid:com.encrypt.bwt.name: SecureYourChats
fdroid:com.encrypt.bwt.summary: Text & File Encryption/Decryption with new OverlayTechnology
fdroid:com.encrypt.bwt.description:
Text Encryption/Decryption
 Supported algorithms: AES, DES, CAMELLIA, ChaCha20-Poly1305, XChaCha20-Poly1305, and Aegis256.
 Intuitive interface to enter text, choose an algorithm, and get the encrypted or decrypted result.
Generate 256-bit Key Automatically
 Automatically generate random 256-bit keys in the Manage Keys section.
 Ideal for encrypting/decrypting without manually creating keys.
Share/Import Encryption Keys via QR
 Share any key you’ve created so others can use the same encryption key.
 Export your key by pressing it in the list and choosing “Export.”
 Import a key using a QR code in “Import key via QR” under key management.
File Encryption/Decryption
 Select files from your device.
 Encrypt or decrypt them using the same algorithms.
 The output file name is automatically labeled “.encrypted” or “.decrypted.”
Built-In Key Manager :key:
 Add, delete, or generate random keys.
 Import keys from QR codes or export them as QR codes too.
 Keys are stored securely (using EncryptedSharedPreferences).
Share Encryption Flow
 Use the Share action in other apps → choose “Encrypt” or “Decrypt” for text/files.
 Quick and convenient for multi-app workflows.
Optional Accessibility Service :handshake:
 Detects selected text (when you highlight text on-screen).
 Detects copied text (clipboard).
 Displays a notification to encrypt/decrypt on the fly, opening the same activity (DialogFlowEncryptionActivity) with “Choose Operation.”
Toggle Accessibility Logic
 A “BurbujaEncryption” button (or similar) enables/disables the logic internally without turning off the service in Android Settings.
 Perfect for pausing detection without leaving system settings.
Dialog Flow (DialogFlowEncryptionActivity) :speech_balloon:
 A step-by-step sequence:
 “Choose Operation” (Encrypt/Decrypt)
 “Choose Cipher”
 “Pick/Enter Key”
 Final result
 Offers a guided, user-friendly experience.
Android 13+ Support
 Requests POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission if you want to see notifications when text is selected or copied.
Basic Usage :rocket:
Main Screen
 Enter text and a key (or pick a saved key).
 Select the algorithm from the spinner.
 Tap Encrypt or Decrypt.
 Copy or share the resulting text.
File Encryption :file_folder:
 Tap “FILE ENCRYPTION” on the main screen (MainActivity).
 Choose a file and an output folder.
 Pick the algorithm and a key.
 Tap EXECUTE.
Accessibility (Optional)
 Enable it in Settings → Accessibility → “Encrypt-DecrypT Service.”
 Once enabled, selecting or copying text in any app triggers a notification.
 Tap it to open the DialogFlow (“Choose Operation”).
 In MainActivity, use “BurbujaEncryption” to enable or disable detection without turning the service off in Settings.
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) :question:
 How do I enable/disable the accessibility service logic without going to system settings?
 Use the “BurbujaEncryption” button in MainActivity. It toggles an internal SharedPreferences flag. If disabled, the service won’t process events even if it’s still enabled in system settings.
 What if I forget my key?
 You won’t be able to decrypt your text/file. Make sure you keep a record of your keys or store them in the Key Manager.
 Why am I not seeing notifications when copying text?
 On Android 13+, you must grant the POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission.
 Check that the accessibility service is enabled and the internal logic is not toggled off.

fdroid:com.infomaniak.meet.description:

No e-mail address, no advertising and no registration are required. Your discussions are not analysed and are only transmitted through Infomaniak servers in Switzerland.

fdroid:com.saadibra.graymatter.summary: An active knowledge-management and multi-modal note-taking platform.
fdroid:com.saadibra.graymatter.description:
Most knowledge-management tools are glorified bookmarks. You gather articles, highlight text, save links, and then forget everything. Relatrix changes that. Built on a single, uncompromising philosophy: Information only becomes knowledge when you engage with it through active reflection. Every resource you save is a starting point, not a destination. Relatrix provides a multi-modal toolkit to break down, question, and connect information across diverse formats.
Feature Overview:
- Topic Library: Organise your intellectual world into curated folders of resources. Visually organize topics with a fully customizable color picker. You can add web links, PDFs, markdown notes, and absolutely any kind of file as a resource.
- Multi-Modal Resource Timeline: A single chronological feed that unifies your reflections, annotations, and visual captures.
- Tag Management Hub: Manage, explore, and filter your resources across all topics using custom tags.
- Reflection-First Entry: When you save a PDF, web page, markdown note, or any other kind of file, Relatrix encourages you to capture an Opinion immediately.
- Knowledge Links & Tags: Cross-reference other resources, topics, or insights using [[double-bracket]] wiki-style links and organize entries with custom tags using a unified dropdown.
- PDF Reader & Annotation: Flip pages, highlight passages, create bookmarks, and perform web lookups.
- Note Editor: A minimalist markdown canvas designed for clarity.
- Relatrix 3D Knowledge Discovery: A live, physics-simulated 3D graph that renders the connective tissue of your knowledge base.

fdroid:org.underfoot.summary: Track walking pad sessions to Health Connect. No account, no analytics.
fdroid:org.underfoot.description:
Underfoot records your walks on a UREVO walking pad and saves them to Health Connect. There is no account and no login.
When the pad is on, the app connects over Bluetooth, records the session while the belt runs, and writes steps, distance, time and calories to Health Connect when you stop. Supported pad: UREVO URTM059. Other pads in the same family may work but are untested.
Steps and calories are estimated from your weight and height (entered once in Settings, stored on the device) when the pad does not report them. Each walk shows which values were reported by the pad and which were estimated.
Requires Health Connect (built in on Android 14 and later, a separate app on older versions).

apple-itunes:1215653304.description:

SMART SCAN – START WITH A CLEARER PICTURE

ORBIT – KEEP YOUR FAMILY IN VIEW

apple-macos:6774523656.name: Zasder Weather
apple-macos:6774523656.description:
Zasder Weather is a clean, fast app for personal weather stations on iPhone, Apple Watch and Mac. One purchase, every platform.
It is bring-your-own backend: point it at your own server, and your station's data is yours, end to end. No ads, no tracking, no subscriptions.
WORKS WITH YOUR STATION
• AmbientWeather, Davis WeatherLink, WeatherFlow Tempest and Ecowitt from their clouds, an Ecowitt gateway posting straight to your server, or a WeatherLink Live read on your network for two-second freshness.
• Direct radio capture: a $20 LilyGO board decodes AcuRite Atlas or Fine Offset, Ecowitt and Ambient sensors off the air.
• AirGradient and Govee air monitors with CO2 and PM2.5, and soil probes on up to eight channels.
• No server yet? The Mac app builds one on your Fly.io account in a minute, or run the backend in Docker.
THE DASHBOARD
• Live conditions, a 24-hour curve, today's highlights ranked against your own record, the moments the weather changed, and a strip that says hour by hour whether each source was healthy.
• Arrange every screen: drag the cards into your order, hide what you do not need, and do the same for Charts.
• A 7-day forecast with a written narrative, tap a day for its full text, and a scorecard of how right the forecast has been at your station.
• Charts with a wind rose, station comparison, and drag to inspect. Explore any past day. Records in under a second. Insights, a year heatmap and a Science page of derived numbers.
ALERTS THAT ARRIVE
• Thresholds on any field, evaluated on your server, by push and email even when the app is closed.
• Weather watches with no setup: lightning nearby with an all clear, frost, heat, a fast pressure drop, a gust front, the first frost, low batteries and a sensor gone quiet.
• Severe weather from the National Weather Service, one family at a time: mute floods and keep tornadoes, with a warning that sounds different from a watch.
• Storm summaries after the rain ends: total, peak rate, temperature drop and top gust, as a push, an email card or both.
• Live Activities on your Lock Screen for the rain countdown, a storm in progress, lightning nearby, a wind ramp, a freeze night and a heat day, and they reach the Apple Watch Smart Stack.
• Quiet hours, a morning report and an evening outlook at the minute you choose, sky notes before sunset, and report emails in the look you pick.
SHARE IT
• Read only links for family with one tap setup, and Sites to keep every server you are given beside your own.
• Your station on the shared map at maps.zasder.com with the location rounded as much as you like.
• Send your readings to Weather Underground, PWSweather, Windy, Weathercloud, CWOP, Met Office WOW, AWEKAS and OpenWeatherMap.
• Story cards from your own record, a public dashboard page to embed on your site, NOAA-style reports, and an AI assistant connected to your server.
ON YOUR WRIST AND HOME SCREEN
• Apple Watch app with configurable complications and a Big complication per reading.
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, editable per widget, a dashboard widget the size of a page, and a widget that follows the station you choose.
• Siri: ask for any reading, the forecast, rain totals or records, in your units. Your stations appear in Spotlight.
YOUR DATA, YOUR RULES
• Bring years of history from Weather Underground, a WeeWX database, or any CSV, and export every reading to CSV.
• Calibrate any sensor with an offset or a scale, typed in your units.
• Units: °F or °C, mph, km/h, knots, m/s or Beaufort, in or mm, inHg or hPa. Light, dark, or automatic. Dynamic Type throughout.
• Settings backed up to iCloud, the server's database backed up from the app, one-tap server updates.
The backend is open source (MIT): https://github.com/volneydouglas/zasder-weather-backend
Data goes only to your server and what you opt into. Optional tip jar via In-App Purchase, purely cosmetic; nothing is paywalled. Requires iOS 18.

- 易用介面 ：彈出視窗中即可複製當前 TOTP；可搜尋與整理項目。
 本附加元件 不會 蒐集、上傳或分享任何個人資料或使用資料。 
使用方式
 點擊工具列圖示開啟彈出視窗。
 透過「＋」按鈕匯入 otpauth:// 文字清單，或在有 QR 的頁面上使用「擷取與辨識」快捷鍵（依頁面權限而定）。
 於清單中搜尋、複製當前的 TOTP。
權限說明
 storage ：將 TOTP 設定保存在本機（必要）。
 activeTab / tabs ：在使用者主動互動時，暫時取得目前分頁以傳遞動作（如擷取可視區畫面並在頁面上顯示提示窗）。
 scripting ：在使用者操作下，將必要腳本注入目前分頁以完成 QR 辨識與互動提示。
 hosts: <all_urls>、file:// *：為了支援在多數網站及本機檔案檢視頁辨識 QR，內容腳本需掛載；若僅需在特定站點使用，建議在附加元件管理頁收斂站點權限。
 我們的程式碼以 最小必要權限 為原則設計；所有邏輯（包含 QR/影像處理）皆在本機執行。 
隱私與安全
 本機儲存，無雲端同步、無遙測。
 不會主動發出任何網路請求。

firefox-addons:857086.name: Clear Browsing Data
firefox-addons:857086.summary: Delete browsing data directly from the browser toolbar. Clear cookies, history and cache with a single click.
firefox-addons:857086.description:
Clear Browsing Data is a Firefox extension which enables you to delete browsing data, such as cookies, history and cache, directly from the browser toolbar. The toolbar button can be configured to clear all browsing data with a single click, or to show a list of data types available for clearing.
Clear Browsing Data is an open source project made possible thanks to a community of awesome supporters. If you'd like to support the continued development of the extension, please consider contributing with Patreon , PayPal or Bitcoin .
The extension also supports closing and reloading tabs, these features can be configured from the extension's options.
 Supported data types: 
 Cookies
 Browsing history
 Cached images and files
 Autofill form data
 Download history
 Service Workers
 Local storage data
 IndexedDB data
 Plugin data
The data types and their order can be customized from the extension's options.
Relevant Firefox bugs:
 Data saved with the Cache API is not cleared ( 1526246 )
 The HTTP authentication cache is not cleared ( 1535606 )
 Clearing downloads only removes them from the current session, downloads from previous sessions can be removed by clearing the history ( 1380445 )
 The cache and local storage are cleared entirely regardless of the requested time interval
 Clearing the history also removes downloads and service workers
The extension is also available for Chrome and Edge .
The developer does not collect any personal data from this extension, visit the extension's privacy policy for more information.
 Reviews are not monitored for bug reports, please use GitHub for issues and feature requests. 
 https://github.com/dessant/clear-browsing-data

firefox-addons:852803.name: Mouse & Video
firefox-addons:852803.summary: This extension allows you to seek, switch to fullscreen, change volume, brightness, playback speed and move any html5 video to a popup window by using the mouse wheel.
firefox-addons:852803.description:
The video player will be divided like in the image above. These divisions are hidden. Scroll up or down on these areas to control the player.
- You can change the brightness by holding the 'Shift' key and scrolling up or down anywhere within the video player.
- To reset the playback speed, quickly scroll up and down or vice versa in the 'SPEED' area.
 To be able to switch the video to fullscreen you have to follow the steps below: 
Type 'about:config' in the address bar.
Click 'I accept the risk'
Type 'full-screen-api.allow-trusted-requests-only' and change its value to false 
 How to use the popup feature: 
When the video is not in fullscreen mode, scrolling down on the "Fullscreen/Popup" area will move the video to a popup window. In the popup, scrolling up on that same area ( * Note: It's not possible to switch to fullscreen when in the popup. ) will close the popup and activate the video's tab, while scrolling down will also close the popup but not change the tab you're currently browsing.
 Shortcut for the popup: 
 Scroll down + Scroll up + Scroll down quickly anywhere on the page you're browsing to move a video to the popup if there's only one playing. In case there's more than one video playing in different tabs, a box will appear at the bottom of the page so that you choose one to move to the popup by clicking on it's corresponding image. There are a few pages where this shortcut will not work like in Firefox's New Tab, preferences page and mozilla.org pages.
Click the icon on the address bar to enable/disable the extension.
It only supports HTML5 players.

firefox-addons:2613532.name: Delinea Web Password Filler
firefox-addons:2613532.summary: Delinea’s web password manager backed by Delinea's flagship vaulting solution (Secret Server) for Privileged Access Management.
firefox-addons:2613532.description: The Delinea Web Password Filler (WPF) browser extension manages credentials for web sites and web applications using Delinea's flagship vaulting solution to save, manage and autofill credentials. WPF can be used by customers that use the Delinea Platform, Delinea Secret Server Cloud or Delinea Secret Server on-premise vaults. WPF supports enterprise single sign-on (SSO) using several mechanisms like Integrated Windows Authentication, SAML, and OpenID. It also supports MFA options such as the Delinea Mobile App, Duo, TOTP authenticator apps, email, FIDO2/YubiKey and others. WPF goes beyond basic password management by seamlessly integrating with the Delinea vault’s advanced credential sharing workflows like approval-before-access, exclusive time-limited checkout/checkin access, MFA-on-access, etc. WPF can also be configured to record user-activity to meet audit and compliance needs.

firefox-addons:867299.name: Save Tabs
firefox-addons:867299.summary: Save and restore all tabs from toolbar popup!
firefox-addons:867299.description:
Save tabs is a Firefox addon that helps you close all tabs with just one click from your browser toolbar. 
Simply open toolbar popup UI and click on the - Close tabs - button on the top section (middle button). In order to restore all closed tabs please click on the - Restore tabs - button on top left corner in toolbar popup UI. 
Within the toolbar popup UI, you will also see the list of tabs. You can easily reorder the items in this list to you desired order (drag & drop). All open tabs will be adapted automatically to the new order. Besides, you can click on the close button in toolbar popup UI to close a single tab (and remove it from the list). 
Once you make any changes in toolbar popup UI, the exact change will appear for all open tabs in your browser; vice versa, once you make any change for open tabs, the toolbar popup UI will see the exact change.
Note: in order to report bugs, please fill the bug report form in the addon homepage .
